xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex009042025-12-0113-23-38" status="finalized"><lb n="28b2"/> yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">slob dpon dag</rs> snga ma ltar cha dgur byas pa'i phyed dang brgyad 'das ste phyed ‹dang› gnyis lus pa na'o zhes gsung yang | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bdag gi bla ma</rs> <note type="editorial">Probably 'Bya 'dul 'dzin (ID:3818)</note> ni mtshan mo la nam phyed yan chad la gnyis dang | de man chad la gnyis te <choice><sic>me</sic><corr>mel</corr></choice>tse'i thun bzhi yin la | bzhi po de re re la yang gnyis gnyis te brgyad yod pa'i bzhi'i tha ma de la gnyis su <lb n="28b3"/> byas pa'i dang po'i phyed nas <note type="gloss">°°°°° po'i phy(e)d na</note> mar bar gzhung gzhan gyi sgo nas kyang grub po zhes de ltar mdzad do ||</seg></TEI>
